transcript: Most people have no idea that this spot right behind your ear can reset your entire system. If you suffer from headaches, neck and shoulder pain or just constant stress and bad posture, try this simple technique right now. It works fast. Take three fingers and find the small lump just behind your ear. Gently massage it in circular motions, five times, then slowly brush down along the muscle behind your ear, down your neck. Do this on both sides, about 12 times, and notice how your whole body starts to release. Even your nervous system begins to calm down. Try it for yourself and feel the difference. If you want my full guide on how to calm your nervous system permanently, comment calm and I'll send it to you for free.
